verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Salisbury Road in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Hong Kong, Salisbury Road, Kowloon, Hong Kong, SAR

verified_facts.text: Spring Moon has held one Michelin star for ten consecutive years, 2017 to 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: MICHELIN One Star for ten consecutive years (2017–2026) and Black Pearl One Diamond for seven consecutive years (2020–2026).

verified_facts.text: Spring Moon has a dedicated tea counter with over 25 selected Chinese teas.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a dedicated tea counter featuring over 25 selected Chinese teas

verified_facts.text: Gaddi's has served French cuisine since 1953 and pioneered the city's first Chef's Table experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1953, Gaddi’s has set the standard for French fine dining in Hong Kong, serving refined French cuisine in an elegant setting and pioneering the city’s first Chef’s Table experience.

verified_facts.text: Gaddi's holds one Michelin star.
verified_facts.excerpt: French - One Michelin Star

verified_facts.text: Felix serves modern European cuisine high above Victoria Harbour in a space designed by Philippe Starck.
verified_facts.excerpt: High above Victoria Harbour, Felix pairs modern European cuisine with Philippe Starck’s iconic avant-garde design and sweeping views of the harbour and the skylines of Hong Kong Island and Kowloon.

verified_facts.text: The Lobby offers all-day international dining and classic English Afternoon Tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: A timeless Hong Kong gathering place, The Lobby offers refined all-day international dining and classic English Afternoon Tea.

verified_facts.text: Chesa has served Swiss Alpine cuisine in a chalet setting since 1965.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1965, Chesa has brought the warmth of a Swiss mountain chalet to Hong Kong, serving hearty Alpine cuisine and fostering generations of convivial gatherings.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's fleet includes Rolls-Royce Extended Wheelbase Phantoms and four Bentley Bentayga Extended Wheelbase Azure SUVs.
verified_facts.excerpt: which includes Rolls-Royce Extended Wheelbase (EWB) Phantoms and four newly added Bentley Bentayga Extended Wheelbase (EWB) Azure SUVs

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers helicopter transport and flightseeing from its twin helipads.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Hong Kong also offers guests the option of helicopter transport and flightseeing via the hotel's dedicated twin helipads.

verified_facts.text: Guests in the Marco Polo Suite get complimentary use of a Rolls-Royce Phantom with a personal chauffeur.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests staying at this truly remarkable Suite are offered the ultimate in Peninsula decadence, the complimentary use of a Phantom Rolls-Royce with personal chauffeur.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Courtyard Rooms overlook the hotel's historical forecourt and fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Deluxe Courtyard Rooms have a magnificent view of the hotel's historical forecourt, glittering fountain and its fleet of Rolls-Royces.

verified_facts.text: The indoor pool has a classically Roman poolside setting with views of the Hong Kong skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Uninterrupted views of the Hong Kong skyline amid a palatial, classically Roman poolside setting

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has an open-air terrace overlooking Victoria Harbour.
verified_facts.excerpt: State-of-the-art fitness equipment, spacious gym facilities and an open air terrace overlooking Victoria Harbour inspire the ultimate workout

verified_facts.text: The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.

verified_facts.text: Six spa treatment rooms have views over Victoria Harbour, and a couples' spa suite has a harbour-view whirlpool tub for two.
verified_facts.excerpt: Six deluxe treatment rooms have stunning views over Victoria Harbour; the singularly luxurious couples’ spa suite, boasting an enormous harbour-view whirlpool tub for two

verified_facts.text: The spa uses product lines including Margy's Monte Carlo and Voya.
verified_facts.excerpt: including Margy’s Monte Carlo and Voya

verified_facts.text: The minimum age for The Peninsula Spa is 16.
verified_facts.excerpt: The minimum age is 16 for access to and treatments at The Peninsula Spa.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments require advance reservation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Advance reservation is required.

verified_facts.text: Peninsula Time allows arrival as early as 6am and departure as late as 10pm, complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt: With Peninsula Time, enjoy arrival as early as 6am and stay through 10pm at every Peninsula hotel worldwide and always with our compliments.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 33.9 km from the airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: 33.9 km / 21.06 miles

verified_facts.text: Spring Moon requires closed-toe shoes, long trousers and sleeved shirts for gentlemen at dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: During dinner period, closed-toe shoes, long trousers and sleeved shirts are required for gentlemen.
